entry.title: SpaceX Seeks to Raise $75 Billion in Record IPO
entry.summary: SpaceX is seeking to raise $75 billion in an initial public offering that would be the biggest of all time. Elon Musk’s rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company plans to market about 555.6 million shares for $135 each, according to its filing Wednesday with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Bloomberg's Manuel Baigorri reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Fmr. SEC Chair: Giants Like SpaceX Need To Find Revenue Model
entry.summary: Gary Gensler, former chair of both the CFTC and SEC, discusses the capital markets and the regulatory challenges they face. The discussion highlights the anticipated surge in IPO activity in 2026, with reported estimates of capital raised reaching up to $75 billion. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
